market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham have been a stable mid-table Premier League side, finishing between 6th and 16th in the last five seasons. Their squad quality and financial resources make a relegation in the specific 2025–26 season unlikely, with similar clubs historically facing ~10–15% annual risk. The market price of 34.5% substantially overestimates this probability.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 14th in 2022–23 and 9th in 2023–24, showing no sign of collapse.
Historically, mid-table clubs of West Ham's stature get relegated in about 1–3 seasons out of 20, implying ~5–15% per-season risk.
No significant squad exodus or financial crisis is expected that would drastically weaken them for 2025–26.
sources_consulted: West Ham United financial reports and squad profiles
